DMRD (Diploma in Medical Radio Diagnosis)
We are looking for a qualified and skilled Radiologist to join our healthcare team in Mumbai on a full-time basis.
The selected candidate will be responsible for accurate interpretation of diagnostic imaging studies, timely reporting, and coordination with referring clinicians to support quality patient care.
Perform and interpret diagnostic imaging procedures including Ultrasound, X-Ray,
Provide accurate, clear, and timely radiology reports.
Correlate imaging findings with clinical information.
Communicate significant findings with referring doctors when required.
Freshers and experienced Radiologists may apply, depending on the role requirements.
Competitive Salary – As per experience and interview
Professional and supportive work environment
Opportunity to work with modern diagnostic facilities
Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.
